Morse, Frost and Taggart each drive one of a Jaguar, a Ford and a Vauxhall. Morse drives the Jaguar, and Frost doesn't drive the Vauxhall. Who drives the Vauxhall?
why: Morse has the Jaguar, so Frost has the Ford, leaving the Vauxhall for Taggart.

text: A soap is shown every Monday, Wednesday and Friday. Episode 1 goes out on a Monday. On which day is episode 10 shown?
why: Episodes 1, 4, 7 and 10 all fall on Mondays.

text: F comes a certain number of letters before M in the alphabet. Which letter comes the same number of letters after M?
why: F is 7 before M, and 7 after M is T.

text: Count every letter E in EMMERDALE, EASTENDERS and NEIGHBOURS put together. How many is that?
why: EMMERDALE has 3, EASTENDERS has 3 and NEIGHBOURS has 1.
